name: MMLU-Pro
description: Harder multi-task knowledge and reasoning benchmark (10-choice questions across 14 domains). Retired: labs stopped reporting it during 2026, so scores already on record stay but it is no longer charted or counted toward frontier status.

name: GPQA Diamond
description: Graduate-level, Google-proof science questions (hardest split). PhD experts score ~65%.

name: SWE-bench Verified
description: Real GitHub issues resolved end-to-end in real repositories; the standard agentic coding benchmark.

name: SWE-bench Pro
description: Harder successor to SWE-bench Verified: long-horizon, multi-file issues from newer repositories chosen to resist training-data contamination. Public split; the figure most labs now report instead of Verified.

name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
description: Long-horizon agentic tasks executed in a real terminal; increasingly reported in place of SWE-bench Verified. Version 2.1 only — 2.0 scores are not comparable and are left unset.

name: AIME (latest)
description: American Invitational Mathematics Examination — competition math, no tools unless noted. Retired: labs stopped reporting it during 2026, so scores already on record stay but it is no longer charted or counted toward frontier status.

name: Humanity's Last Exam
description: 2,500 expert-written frontier questions across dozens of fields; designed to resist saturation.

name: LMArena Elo
description: Crowd-sourced head-to-head preference rating from LMArena (formerly Chatbot Arena).

name: GDPval-AA v2
description: Artificial Analysis' Elo rating for economically valuable knowledge work — real occupational tasks (documents, spreadsheets, analyses) judged pairwise. Measured by Artificial Analysis, not lab-reported.

name: ARC-AGI-2
description: Abstraction-and-reasoning puzzles that are easy for humans and hard for models.
